verdict.rationale: Supabase documents self-hosting, saying you can "Deploy Supabase within your own infrastructure using Docker Compose" for full data control or isolated environments. The GitHub repo positions the stack as built on open source tools, and the CLI can run the entire Supabase stack locally, which a hands-on probe confirms initializes headlessly with no login. The community question about how hard self-hosting is reads as skepticism, not concrete contradicting evidence. Missing for 10: in-depth self-hosting documentation beyond brief overview quotes, any statement of feature parity with the hosted platform, and independent hands-on corroboration of a production self-hosted deployment.
